exact_statement: For all a>=1, even m>=4, and arbitrary two-bit activation masks A_j, the actual Boolean product of disjoint paired-quadratic private m-bit cores point-edited by A_j on two shared bits has delta=2^-m, J=am/2+2m delta sum E A_j, I=J+d and d<=4delta sum E A_j. Its prescribed two-shared-query stopping tree has exact raw derivative bill T=T_private+2E_zw, exclusive private allocations T_private=2sum u_j with u_j<=J_j, and 2E_zw<=d, hence exact-K4-localized bill<=T<=2I. With every terminal uniform-mask cost am retained, am+T+(3/ln2)d<=4I. The explicit fixed reference Q(L,R)=2^-am times the actual shared spectral conditional derived from the four closed terminal spectra is normalized and has complete CE=am+B_block<=am+2<=3I; the same owned ledger also pays this reference. For a=2, A1=AND and A2=OR, the root is ANF-connected, both shared influences are delta, I=m+(2m+2)delta, T=(4m+1)delta(1+delta), root B/Inf>=(1-delta)^2(m-1)/2 and both descendants B/Inf>=m-1. All three nodes are K4-bad for every even m>=12, although T/I tends to0 and CE/I tends to2. No universal arbitrary-core or unbounded-separator-width policy is claimed.
